other.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted riff centered on E. A second electric guitar provides sustained power chords and melodic lead fills with high-gain saturation. The bass guitar follows the kick drum patterns with a gritty, overdriven tone. Drums feature a prominent double-kick pedal technique, a crisp snare with a short decay, and consistent 16th-note hi-hat patterns. 140 BPM, 4/4 time signature, E minor.

bass.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A detuned, warbling electric piano plays a repetitive four-chord progression with heavy flutter and wow effects. A sampled acoustic drum loop features a muffled kick, a crisp snare with a short room reverb, and a steady eighth-note closed hi-hat pattern. A deep, rounded sub-bass follows the root notes of the piano chords. A vinyl crackle texture and occasional bird chirping foley are layered throughout the mix. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of C major. The piano uses a low-pass filter that opens and closes slightly over four-bar cycles. A subtle sidechain compression effect causes the melodic elements to duck slightly on every kick drum hit.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[vinyl crackle, bird chirping foley]
[detuned electric piano enters with four-chord progression]

[Main Section]
[sampled drum loop enters with muffled kick and crisp snare]
[sub-bass follows piano root notes]
[low-pass filter automation on piano]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[piano fades out with increasing reverb]
[vinyl crackle and bird chirping continue to silence]

drums.tags: Boom bap hip hop. A dry, acoustic drum kit plays a swung 16th-note groove with a prominent, thumping kick and a crisp snare. A deep, melodic electric bass guitar line follows a syncopated pattern with subtle slides between notes. A clean, jazz-influenced electric guitar plays rhythmic, staccato chords on the off-beats. A high-pitched, filtered synthesizer lead performs a repetitive, two-bar melodic hook with a slight portamento effect. 92 BPM. Key of C minor. 4/4 time signature.
